purpose: Ablation study: measure the contribution of each term that PR #6 adds to the evaluation and to the move ordering, against the pinned baseline 6ab5b3349264c6c0a740c433ce454f8e1fed698a.
note: Every variant runs the same 100 paired openings (200 real UCI games) with the same seed, so the variants are paired samples over the same openings. The ablation switch is honoured by the candidate only: the pinned baseline predates the module and ignores the variable.
revision_note: Revision 1 (seed 20261124, extended profile, 600 games) measured the pre-refinement head: 217 W / 164 D / 219 L, score 49.8%, relative Elo -23.2 to +21.5 (95% CI), INCONCLUSIVE. Revision 2 (seed 20261130, extended profile) measures the refined head. Revision 3 failed in the request resolver because the screen profile was not in its whitelist; revision 4 is the same ablation study with the resolver fixed.
interpretation: Ablation output is a diagnostic, not a rating and not a strength claim. A variant that scores higher than another only says that the ablated term costs score points against this one opponent at a fixed movetime.
